notes: Synchronous calls: search is a gRPC server (services/search/server.go:67 pb.RegisterSearchServer, line 66 grpc.NewServer). It makes two gRPC client calls: to the geo service (server.go:70 s.initGeoClient("srv-geo"), call site server.go:136 s.geoClient.Nearby) and to the rate service (server.go:73 s.initRateClient("srv-rate"), call site server.go:149 s.rateClient.GetRates). Protocol gRPC over a consul:// resolver target (server.go:121 fmt.Sprintf("consul://%s/%s", s.ConsulAddr, name)), dialled by dialer/dialer.go:55 grpc.Dial with a round_robin balancer config (dialer.go:28) when KnativeDomainName is empty (config.json:26 is the empty string). The consul names srv-geo and srv-rate are the names the callee services register under only if their own server.go says so; those files are not among the given files, so the mapping srv-geo -> geo and srv-rate -> rate is by service key and entrypoint name, not stated here. No database or cache client in search.
Messages: no topics, no producers, no consumers, no consumer groups in these files.

Registry: registers with consul. cmd/search/main.go:55 registry.NewClient(*consulAddr), consulAddress consul:8500 (config.json:2); services/search/server.go:82 s.Registry.Register(name, s.uuid, s.IpAddr, s.Port) with name = srv-search (server.go:24), called once in Run() before srv.Serve(lis) (server.go:88); Deregister on Shutdown (server.go:93). SearchIP is not in config.json (SearchPort is, line 23), so servIP is empty (cmd/search/main.go:38) and Register falls back to getLocalIP (registry/registry.go:79-80). The AgentServiceRegistration (registry/registry.go:85-90) sets only ID, Name, Port, Address: no Check, TTL, interval or DeregisterCriticalServiceAfter. Heartbeat interval, failure timeout and cleanup interval: not stated in these files (library default, not in these files; the consul agent config is not among the files). No goroutine or call in search code refreshes the registration, so no heartbeat that runs independently of request processing is stated in these files. The consul client is also used for client-side resolution (grpc-consul-resolver import server.go:16).

Container, replicas, health check: image obsplacement-hotel-reservation:6ecb09706140 (harness compose line 13, default of HR_APP_IMAGE; upstream compose line 71 names deathstarbench/hotel-reservation:latest), entrypoint search (upstream compose line 72), replicas: 1 (upstream compose line 77). No health check in the files given: no HEALTHCHECK in hotelReservation/Dockerfile and no healthcheck key in either compose file; restart: always at upstream compose line 75. The Dockerfile (lines 1-19) only builds binaries with go install ./cmd/....

Telemetry: traces only. Jaeger agent address jaeger:6831 (config.json:3, jaegerAddress, read at cmd/search/main.go:42, passed to tracing.Init at main.go:48 as LocalAgentHostPort, tracing/tracer.go:37). Reporter BufferFlushInterval 1 * time.Second (tracing/tracer.go:36). Sampler probabilistic, default ratio 0.01 (tracing/tracer.go:14), overridden by env JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO (tracer.go:20); harness compose sets JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO from ${HR_JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO:-1} (line 15) and JAEGER_DISABLED from ${HR_JAEGER_DISABLED:-false} (line 16); cfg.FromEnv() at tracer.go:42. Spans come from the gRPC server interceptor otgrpc.OpenTracingServerInterceptor (server.go:58) and client interceptor (dialer/dialer.go:21); no manual spans in search code. Logs: zerolog ConsoleWriter to os.Stdout (cmd/search/main.go:22), no log exporter. Metrics: none stated in these files.
